entities.title: Work on Gambit
entities.summary: Install, test and build the game in its folder.
steps: Node 22, and Godot 4.7.2 with its web export templates (GODOT=path if it is not on the PATH as godot)
cd games/chess
npm install
npm test (typecheck, then the TypeScript suites)
npm run test:godot (the GDScript suites)
npm run build (into dist/games/retro/chess/)
entities.verify: npm test and npm run test:godot pass.

entities.title: Run the game locally
entities.summary: The game, its API and a local database on localhost, with the development sign-in.
steps: cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars (DEV_LOGIN=1)
npx wrangler d1 execute chess --local --file worker/schema.sql
npm run dev (exports the game, then wrangler dev)
Open http://localhost:8787/games/retro/chess/ and sign in with the development sign-in; a second browser or a private window is the other player
Or run the desktop build against it: godot --path godot -- --dev-email=you@test.io (no computer opponent on the desktop)
entities.verify: Two players can invite each other and play a game.
entities.details: Never set DEV_LOGIN in production. The development switches (--goto, --moves, --shot and the rest) are in godot/scripts/.dev/configuration.json.

entities.title: Set up production
entities.summary: The one-time owner actions before the first deploy.
entities.when: Only once, by the owner, for a new Cloudflare account or database.
steps: npx wrangler d1 create chess, and put its id in wrangler.jsonc
npx wrangler d1 execute chess --remote --file worker/schema.sql
Deploy icelander.net's accounts Worker first, and put its public keys into ACCOUNTS_JWKS in wrangler.jsonc
Optional: npx wrangler secret put RESEND_API_KEY, and a verified sender in MAIL_FROM
npm run deploy
entities.verify: The game opens at icelander.net/games/retro/chess/ after signing in.

entities.title: Change the database
entities.summary: A schema change is a migration applied by hand before merging.
steps: Add games/chess/worker/migrations/NNNN-what-it-does.sql, numbered from 0002, with a comment saying why (Gambit has no migrations/ folder yet)
Make the same change in worker/schema.sql
Try it locally: npx wrangler d1 execute chess --local --file worker/migrations/<file>
Apply it to production before merging, as docs/database-migrations.md says, and acknowledge it in the pull request's description

entities.title: Retire Gambit's own sign-in
entities.summary: After the move to icelander.net's login service, delete the old OAuth secrets and the sessions table.
entities.when: Once, by the owner, after sign-in through the login service works in production.
steps: Export the players for the login service's import: npx wrangler d1 execute chess --remote --json --command "SELECT email, name, picture, created FROM users" > gambit-users.json
npx wrangler secret delete GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, then GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
npx wrangler d1 execute chess --remote --file worker/retire-sessions.sql
Remove the old redirect URIs …/auth/callback/google (Google Cloud Console) and …/callback/github (the GitHub OAuth app, or delete the app)
entities.verify: Signing in, playing and signing out still work; the sessions table is gone.
entities.details: Whether this has been done is not recorded in the repository.
